1. **F1 — high, blocking, issue-impact:** [`crates/jit/src/commands/validate.rs:926`](crates/jit/src/commands/validate.rs:926) rebuilds every installed profile’s repair claims through `build_profile_repair_claims`, which always resolves with `VariableInputs::default()` ([`apply_claims.rs:36`](crates/jit/src/profile/apply_claims.rs:36)). A profile applied with `--set` therefore validates/repairs against its default value instead of its published content; one without a default errors during validation. This makes a successful non-default variable application immediately appear invalid and allows repair to restore the wrong bytes. The new CLI test verifies emitted content but not subsequent validation. References: @/inv/derived-state-coherence, @/charter/D-8.
